text:
Palladium Price in 2008
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2008, the LBMA palladium price fell 52.8% between 2008-01-31 ($388) and 2008-12-30 ($183). The highest sampled price was $568 in February and the lowest was $183 in December. The mean of these observations was $347. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
What happened in 2008:
The global financial crisis drove waves of safe-haven demand into precious metals.
